next.reason: 1985 'operates as if each selection subject and selection object were evaluated and assigned' a value. §2023:14.9.13.4 GR3 evaluates the subjects at the start but §2023:14.9.13.4 GR4 evaluates objects pair by pair: 'no more pairs in that WHEN phrase are evaluated' and later WHENs are not analyzed. A 1985 (X3.23a-1989) program whose skipped object references FUNCTION RANDOM (§1989:A.2.35.3 AR4 'return the next number in the current sequence') gets a different later value. Value, class and range assignment are kept (§2023:14.9.13.4 GR1, GR2, GR4).
